items.question: What liberation could surpass the supreme purifying liberation already granted at Kāśī?
premises: The speaker grants liberation at Kāśī.
That liberation is described as supreme and purifying.
The listener is asked about desiring to hear of something beyond it.
items.inference: No higher or purer liberation remains to be sought beyond the one already granted.
items.plain_english: What supreme, purifying liberation beyond this do you wish to hear of?
